Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in your opening message in #inc-vtg-hartford. While the lanes were down, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when Mateo logged that the guard had checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

I posted this answer in the channel. The source was the channel history, which you can see.
